shapePlacement.rotationTip: Turn it about its own axis, clockwise (the ring in the 3D view does the same)
shapePlacement.fromSurfaceTip: How far it stands off the surface
shapePlacement.keepUpTip: Keeps it upright while you slide it over the surface or face it to the camera
shapePlacement.faceCameraTip: Turn it to face you, where you look at it from
shapePlacement.moveToolsText: Move or rotate the text with those tools.
shapePlacement.moveToolsShape: Move or rotate the shape with those tools.
shapePlacement.dragText: Drag the text or its blue frame to slide it over the object. The ring turns it.
shapePlacement.dragShape: Drag the shape or its blue frame to slide it over the object. The ring turns it.
